summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Abacus FCF International Leaders ETF (ABLG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund aims to outperform a broad global ex-US equity index. The actively managed fund selects stocks based on free cash flow. ABLG was launched on Jun 27, 2017 and is issued by Abacus.

holdings.infoBox: ABLG is an equity ETF with a total of 51 individual holdings. The top holdings are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company stock at 5.22%, ASML Holding at 4.89%, SK hynix at 4.67%, Advantest at 3.89%, and Rolls-Royce Holdings at 3.19%.
